symbols.name: prime
symbols.meaning: A prime number, the integer whose divisors are classified.

symbols.name: second prime
symbols.meaning: A second prime number, distinct from rho.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma$ be a prime distinct from $\rho$.

symbols.name: divisor
symbols.meaning: A positive integer that divides another integer.
symbols.quote: A positive integer $\xi$ is a divisor of an integer when that integer equals $\xi\eta$ for some integer $\eta$, the cofactor of $\xi$ in that integer.

symbols.name: cofactor
symbols.meaning: The integer that multiplies the divisor to give the integer being divided.
symbols.quote: A positive integer $\xi$ is a divisor of an integer when that integer equals $\xi\eta$ for some integer $\eta$, the cofactor of $\xi$ in that integer.

relations.quote: A prime number is defined as an [Integer](integer.md) greater than one whose only positive divisors are one and itself.

relations.predicate: are used as axis lengths by
relations.quote: Distinct primes are used as axis lengths by a [Chinese-remainder map](chinese-remainder-map.md), which needs its axis lengths pairwise coprime.
Primes give axis lengths for the [radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md).
Each prime is the length of one [cyclic coordinate](cyclic-coordinate.md).
